title: Native Authority Unavailable at Consequence Boundary
purpose: Determine whether V05 natively distinguishes unavailable present-tense authority information from conflict, indeterminacy, or ordinary authority denial and withholds consequence.

condition.initial_authority: Authentic ACTIVE AuthorityState with SEND permission

required_discriminators: Witness does not misclassify the state as CONFLICT or INDETERMINATE
bounded_claim: Success establishes only native representation and deterministic local consequence containment for an explicitly supplied UNAVAILABLE authority-resolution state. It does not establish production service availability, distributed consensus, network freshness, or external authority provenance.
